<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 182.0732 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈181.0659 Da. The formula C₉H₉O₄ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 181.0500 Da, matching the observed mass within typical instrument tolerance and consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ +1 Da). Therefore, the molecular formula of the compound is C9H9O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H9O4</final_answer>
